discovered_locations.quote: She had come to a meadow she had never seen before.

final_location.quote: Then Mira went inside her cozy house, and the little star shone happily in the window all night long.

object_observations.quote: Mira smiled. She still did not know who the stone belonged to. That was a secret for another day. So she kept it close, safe and warm in her hands.
Mira gently set the star down beside the window.

open_obligation_outcomes.quote: Little Mira sat by the window in her cozy home.
Mira did not sit and wait for it to wake up by itself.
